_doc: The closed animation vocabulary. Family A = generated-image cutout layers (the only authorable family). Each entry: author params, the asset image-gen must produce, the Remotion impl + build status. VPW/motion-planner may author ONLY these. Extend deliberately: prove in Remotion -> add the triple -> then author.

cutout._note: Family A. source:'cutout' — a generated image asset composited over the plate. Rigid transforms + reveals only; NO articulation.

shapes.anchor: verbatim VO words (opt) — resolved to a shot-relative start_s at build
shapes.anchor_origin: center|bottom (opt) — vertical transform origin; default center for appear. Distinct from `anchor`.
center|bottom (opt) — vertical transform origin; default bottom for bob (`at` y is the element's bottom edge unless overridden).
center|bottom (opt) — vertical transform origin; default bottom for slide (feet-on-ground). Set 'center' for a non-figure slide like an arrow so `to` y means the element's center.

shapes.dot_count: int > 0 (opt, default 44) — number of route dots; requires draw_line. LOWER for a clearly dotted read (44 overlap into a solid bead).
shapes.dot_r: number > 0 (opt, default 5) — dot radius px; requires draw_line. SMALLER widens the gaps.
shapes.static: bool (opt) — completed-route persistence: draw the WHOLE line from frame 0 (ignore progress) + park the cutout at the route end. A later delta-chain shot re-declares an earlier shot's route (same points) with static:true so the drawn line survives the hard cut. Default off = the draw-on animation.
shapes.anchor_origin: center|bottom (opt) — vertical transform origin of the cutout; default center for path.

path.asset: one cutout (line is engine-drawn; static parks it at the route end)
path.engine: bezier sample + optional draw-on / static completed-route
